close_reason: Closed on current evidence at origin/main a3a9761d1. Twelve separate-process enum_predicate_search traces emitted identical ordered drain-arbiter steps and identical job/work-graph event ordering. The fz-kdt.44 changes sort waited settled facts by FactKey data order and flush quiescence at explicit driver boundaries, eliminating the reported arbiter-placement instability. Remaining raw-line differences are separately tracked product-work/canon-definition effects; edge-triggered removal of the scan remains owned by fz-kdt.46.
description:
Found (and confirmed PRE-EXISTING at 2acbc8d04) during fz-kdt.13.1's builds:
enum_predicate_search emits one work_graph.quiesced event at one of two stream
positions across processes; the raw stream also varies in canon-dictionary
emission order. The job+work_graph causal projection is stable, so no gate
catches it, but it is a live crack in the order-is-preserved-never-restored
invariant. Visible cause: settle_quiescent_waits orders candidates by FactKey
Ord over a HashMap-keyed waiter index -- the ordering is fine, but WHEN the
arbiter runs relative to product-wait polls differs cross-process. Ties into
fz-kdt.46 (edge-triggered arbitration) and fz-kdt.47 (cross-process
derivation-order dependence); fold there if the fix coincides.
title: Drain-arbiter emission position is cross-process unstable on enum_predicate_search
